unit.why: The division gives two quoted teachings on Passover: a kabbalistic claim that sins on Passover cause greater damage, and R. Bunem of Peshischa's saying that Passover stringencies are ornaments of holiness; nothing happens to anyone, so there is no narrative.
unit.boundary_note: ends with the heading 'מענין חולי', which introduces the sickness stories in the next division
